title: Token-Lebenszyklus: Refresh, Rotation und Logout
description: As a developer, I want my session to refresh automatically and to end it explicitly, so that I stay signed in without leaving an open session behind.

acceptance_criteria.given: a client holds a valid access token and a valid refresh token
acceptance_criteria.when: the client calls the refresh endpoint with the refresh token
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 200 and a new token pair
and: the previously used refresh token is no longer valid
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-003-token-lifecycle.feature: Refresh returns a new token pair and invalidates the old refresh token

acceptance_criteria.given: a refresh token has already been rotated once
acceptance_criteria.when: an attacker replays the old refresh token
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 401 and invalidates every token of that session chain
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-003-token-lifecycle.feature: Replaying a rotated refresh token invalidates the whole session chain

acceptance_criteria.given: the access token has expired but the refresh token is still valid
acceptance_criteria.when: the client calls a protected resource with the expired access token
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 401 and instructs the client to use the refresh endpoint
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-003-token-lifecycle.feature: An expired access token only passes through the refresh endpoint
